content.text: The Departments of Surgery of Aga Khan University have taken the concept of one university with multiple campuses to a new dimension by organizing the University's first combined surgical conference involving all the four surgical departments of the University including Nairobi, Dar-es-Salaam, Kabul and Karachi. This multinational academic event was held at Nairobi on August 1 and 2, 2014, and was jointly hosted by the Departments of Surgery at Nairobi and Karachi.

The conference was named Aga Khan University Surgical Trans-Indian Ocean Collaboration (AKUSTIC) and the theme of the conference was "Quality Healthcare with Resource Restraints". The topics that came under discussion were Ethics, Research, Cost Effective Surgical Practice and Education and Training. All the participants greatly appreciated the initiative. The last session was dedicated to the formulation of plans for making AKUSTIC an annual event. This session was attended by the Departmental Chairs from Nairobi, Karachi and Dar-es-Salam, Dean, Medical College, Pakistan, and the members of Scientific Committee of the 1st AKUSTIC. AKUSTIC II is proposed to be hosted by AKU, Karachi in the summer of 2015.
